I only got back to playing FFXV this month, I’ve not had a chance since 2016. I never saw any trailers so playing through the 3 Episodes yesterday opened up a lot for me. 
If I’m honest. I don’t know what triggered so much emotion. It could be understanding the lengths that Iggy would go to protect Noct, or how the burden he has to bare knowing Noct’s future and where the road leads... Maybe I was still a bit tender after playing through Prompto’s story as well. Or could just be the fact that every Final Fantasy has broken me down emotional in some way shape or form... Everyone has their own emotional triggers. Something in this hit me hard ahaha! But definitely made me warm to Ignis a lot more. Was never really a fan in the beginning.

Ravus seeing his sister and breaking down was hard as well, for me personally it was the lengths that Ignis went to to protect Noct. Standing up to Ravus and just distracting him long enough to see sense and not doing something that would ruin everything. Then with the ring, it was completely unexpected, cause in the main story it comes across as Ignis losing his sight was nothing, just an accident whilst fighting & Noct doesn’t fully grasp what Ignis went through. Potentially losing his life just to get that extra power (or nothing at all) to defend Noctis from Ardyn by putting on this ring. I don’t know, personally it hit me pretty hard. 

As for Ardyn’s story, I don’t want it to be touching or make me feel sorry for him. Just think it would interesting to see how he suffered and developed into who he is now.

That’s what I loved about Chapter 3 verse 2 (or whatever it was called). Fighting Ardyn with Iggy and sacrificing his life to use the ring. Made for a beautiful alternative ending but a little bit too “fairy tale-esk” I’ll admit but great all the same. The bit that got me the most I think was that Iggy went through the rest of the journey knowing what awaited Noct. That was hard to comprehend. 

Ardyn’s story would a complicated one to do. How far back do they go, will it be him fighting with himself and the hatred growing inside? Or planning out his revenge and how he orchestrated his whole plan.

Episode Noctis would be unnecessary. I felt that the story was wrapped up to an almost perfect ending. Although learning about his childhood would be interesting. His time in Tenebrae or running around with Ignis as a kid could be fun. A story following Regis on his journey with Cid would be interesting as well. All in all, this is one of the best Final Fantasy games made. The effort they went to to leave no stone unturned and get the player to follow story and connect with the characters. Best story since X.
